blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Ariel Joseph Alegarbes won the Philippines’ second gold medal at the 5th Asian Para Games, topping the men’s 100-meter backstroke S14 final in 1 minute, 1.56 seconds on Tuesday at Rainbow Pool in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. The 21-year-old from Victorias City, Negros Occidental, edged South Korea’s Kang Sungho, who clocked 1:01.61, while Thailand’s Natirat Meeprom settled for bronze in 1:02.08. Alegarbes entered the final with the second-fastest qualifying time before producing the winning swim. His gold followed Ernie Gawilan’s victory in the men’s 400-meter freestyle S7 on Monday.
